Employment Situation News Release

                            THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION - NOVEMBER 2025


Total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 64,000 in November, and the unemployment rate increased
by 0.2 percentage point to 4.6 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. The
unemployment rate for teenagers rose to 15.0 percent.

Household Survey Data

The unemployment rate for Black workers edged up to 8.3 percent in November.
